response.sql: SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_cost_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY original_language_id ORDER BY film_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The schema defines both rental_rate (NOT NULL DEFAULT 4.99) and rental_duration (NOT NULL DEFAULT 3) as non-nullable, so 'ignoring missing values' in the average is handled transparently—NULL division results are automatically excluded by AVG().
